reasoning: This question asks whether average US regular gas prices will increase over a 7-day period (Oct 11-18, 2026). Gas prices are highly volatile and influenced by global oil markets, geopolitical events, refinery capacity, and seasonal demand. Over a single week, prices can move in either direction with roughly equal probability in the absence of specific shocks. Historical data shows weekly gas price changes are roughly symmetric around zero. Without knowledge of specific events occurring in October 2026, the probability of an increase versus decrease over this short timeframe should be close to 50%.
